stem.text: The diagram shows the electric field pattern between two opposite and unequal point charges P and Q.

stem.alt: Electric field pattern of two point charges, labelled P on the left and Q on the right, with field lines drawn between and around them, arrowed to show direction.

stem.text: Which statement about the charges is correct?

A.text: P is negatively charged and has a smaller charge than Q.

B.text: P is negatively charged and has a greater charge than Q.

C.text: P is positively charged and has a smaller charge than Q.

D.text: P is positively charged and has a greater charge than Q.
